issues.detail: The 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' row uses the Flood Risk Assessment trigger (1 ha in Flood Zone 1, or Flood Zones 2 and 3). The foul sewage trigger is lost.
issues.evidence: 'Foul sewage and utilities assessment A Flood Risk Assessment (FRA) will be required for development proposals of 1 hectare or greater in Flood Zone 1...'

issues.detail: The 'Self-build / custom build information' row has the Environmental Statement (EIA) trigger. The only self-build reference is a broken URL to CIL self-build exemption guidance. This is a CIL relief note, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'reliefs. ov.uk/blog/guidance/communityinfrastructure-levy/relief/self-buildexemption/#paragraph_149 Environmental statement The Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations...'

issues.detail: The 'Validation checklist form (completed)' row uses the Biodiversity Checklist sentence as its trigger, duplicating the Biodiversity Checklist row. The actual local form, the Planning Application Requirements (PAR) Checklist, is only in the tab and has no app-type row.
issues.evidence: 'A completed Test Valley Biodiversity Checklist should be submitted with the application...'

issues.detail: Several triggers are sentence fragments with no statement of when the item applies. Design and Access Statement: 'concept in a Design and Access Statement, if required.' LVIA: 'such as a landscape and visual impact assessment.' Planning Statement: 'statement or planning statement.' CIL: 'of the CIL Regulations 2010 (as amended).' Heritage Statement: 'The scope and degree of detail ... will vary'.

All 16 general requirements are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', while Householder, Outline and Reserved matters show '(none)'. Grokbot's own excerpts show several items apply to any application. The Biodiversity Checklist 'should be submitted with the application'. A tree survey applies 'where there are trees within the application site or on land adjacent'. Parking applies 'where parking arrangements are changing'. FRA applies to 'all proposals for new development located in Flood Zones 2 and 3'.
issues.evidence: Householder row: 'No specific local requirements identified for this application type'

issues.detail: A tab item is an information note about COM7 affordable housing contributions with a broken URL, not a validation requirement.
issues.evidence: 'Planning Advice Note – Revised Local Plan Policy COM7 ... v.uk/assets/files/10192/pp1-2-160118COM7-Advice-note-v.5.pdf For information - ...'

issues.detail: The Environmental Statement row is a national statutory requirement under the EIA Regulations, not a local one. Its excerpt has a garbled SI number ('SI 011/1824' instead of SI 2011/1824) and the broken CIL URL fragment.
issues.evidence: '(SI 011/1824), set out the circumstances in which an Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is required.'
issues.grok_comment: The point that the ES is a national requirement is valid, but "SI 011/1824" is verbatim in the council's PDF (raw 1c0f41890c line 197), so it is not an extraction error by Grokbot.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. The SI number is verbatim from the council; the point that the ES is national, not local, stands.

issues.detail: The 'Planning page' is set to the council homepage (https://www.testvalley.gov.uk), not the planning requirements page. Only one document was read (docs_read = 1). The PAR checklist and the Biodiversity Checklists it refers to were not read.

summary: The live source could not be fetched because the shared WebFetch budget was used up, so whether the link is current is unknown. Grokbot's 'Descriptions List' is dated 2016 or 2017 and cites 2012-NPPF paragraphs, so it is probably out of date. Grokbot's extraction has swapped triggers (FRA text on foul sewage, EIA text on self-build), a duplicate checklist row, fragment triggers, and every requirement guessed into Full planning only.

withdrawn_issues.detail: The list date is inconsistent with its own evidence. The date basis is the text 'updated 15 March 2016', but the date is recorded as 2016-03-01, and the file name is 'Descriptions-List-2017'. The excerpts also cite 2012-NPPF paragraph numbers (56, 57, 61, 109, 115, 118), so the content predates NPPF 2018 or later. The list is at least eight years old and is likely superseded or due for review.
withdrawn_issues.evidence: Date basis: 'text: updated 15 March 2016'; Parking excerpt: 'NPPF paras. 56, 57, 61, 109, 115, 118 and TVBCLP policy E2'
withdrawn_issues.grok_comment: The date is not inconsistent: List_date is stored at month precision, so "updated 15 March 2016" correctly gives 2016-03-01. The workbook already flags it Outdated=Yes, and the "likely superseded" point is speculation with no evidence of a newer list.
withdrawn_issues.claude_response: Accepted. The workbook stores list dates to the month, so the value is right; only the date-basis label could be better. Not a Grokbot error. Outdated is already flagged.
